title: Body-village Is Filled To Overflowing With Sexual
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 171
summary: This shabad opens with the body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which were broken. It turns the heart toward servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace.
whyItMatters: It matters when life feels envious, unsettled, and small because the shabad keeps comparison inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private momentum.
takeaway: Keep returning to this turn: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam karodh nagar bahu bhariaa mil saadhoo kha(n)ddal kha(n)ddaa he ||
lines.translation: The body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhat likhe gur paiaa man har liv ma(n)ddal ma(n)ddaa he ||1||
lines.translation: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar saadhoo a(n)julee pu(n)n vaddaa he ||
lines.translation: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar dda(n)ddaut pun vaddaa he ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat har ras saadh na jaaniaa tin a(n)tar haumai ka(n)ddaa he ||
lines.translation: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the taste of the Lord's sublime essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jiau jiau chaleh chubhai dhukh paaveh jamakaal saheh sir dda(n)ddaa he ||2||
lines.translation: The more they walk away, the deeper it sticks into them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan har har naam samaane dhukh janam maran bhav kha(n)ddaa he ||
lines.translation: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: abinaasee purakh paiaa paramesar bahu sobh kha(n)dd brahama(n)ddaa he ||3||
lines.translation: They have obtained the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they obtain great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham gareeb masakeen prabh tere har raakh raakh vadd vaddaa he ||
lines.translation: I am poor and meek, God, but I am Yours! Save me, please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੨॥੬੦॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam adhaar Tek hai har naame hee sukh ma(n)ddaa he ||4||8||22||60||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||8||22||60||

structure: It opens by naming the condition without ornament: the body-village is filled to overflowing with sexual desire and anger, which were broken.
The middle movement widens the correction through the more they walk away, the deeper it sticks into them, and the more.
It closes with a return you can actually keep: servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace.
